consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance on July 11, 1970, at Fillmore East was high-energy and memorable, featuring a mix of acoustic and electric sets. Despite some confusion over the setlist and recording quality, many listeners appreciated the unique moments and the overall vibe of the show.
standout_songs: So Sad (To Watch Good Love Go Bad)
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 15 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans praised the performance, the mixed reviews regarding tape quality and setlist confusion led to a sentiment adjustment towards the positive side.
